title: 第十七章巨灵闯祸第十八章赵大爷
slug: 洪荒走向神话的大天尊
content_zh:
南天门祭炼既毕，昊天便吩咐天庭众人各司其职。有往幽冥助建地府者，有留洪荒招揽人手者，诸事皆有条不紊。
昊天自归灵霄宝殿，以元始祖炁祭炼太古星空与三十三重天，天庭既已脱胎换骨，天庭之主干，亦当一并升之。
如此日复一日。
这一日，昊天正闭目凝神，以权柄勾连太古星空深处。忽心念一动，冥冥中有所感应，遂一挥手，昊天镜凭空浮现，悬于面前。
镜面如波，渐渐映出一幅清晰画面。
昊天定睛观瞧，眉头顿皱。
画中有一披金甲、执板斧之魁梧天兵，护着一头黑虎，与一道人遥遥对峙。那天兵满脸横肉，相貌凶恶，却透着一股憨直之气。
“这是巨灵神？”昊天微微一怔。此人乃异种灵兽得道，力大无穷，被太白金星招入天庭，封了个偏将。
依前世记忆，日后当为天将，替天庭征伐四方——然彼乃许久以后之事。今天庭初立，不想此人已入麾下？
昊天目光移向那道人。但见一身青袍，面如冠玉，三缕长髯，眉宇间英气逼人。负手而立，气息如渊如海，大罗金仙之威，纵隔昊天镜亦令人心悸。
“赵公明？”昊天认出了此人。截教外门大弟子，三霄之兄，大罗金仙修为，已入“修道”之境，非寻常修士可比。在截教之中位望隆重，洪荒名头亦是不小。
昊天再看二人对峙之状，不由揉了揉额角。巨灵神不过真仙，连金仙亦未至。赵公明乃大罗金仙，一念之间可灭巨灵神百回。他二人怎会撞上，且是一副剑拔弩张之态？
昊天未急着动身，耐着性子往下看。
---
画面中，赵公明立于巨灵神不远处，未刻意释放威压，然大罗之势如山如岳，压得草木低伏，连空气都似凝了几分。其面色甚是不善。
“谁许你带走本座坐骑？又劫掠本座洞府天材地宝？”赵公明声不大，却字字如雷，震得那黑虎瑟瑟发抖，“尔欺我赵公明耶？”
事情原委却是这般——
上次天庭异动之后，赵公明前往金鳌岛听通天教主讲道。圣人讲法，千载难逢，自不能错过。临行前，他将洞府封禁，嘱坐骑黑虎好生看家。
孰料待他听道归来，回至洞府时，却发现禁制已破，坐骑不见，天材地宝亦被搜刮一空！
赵公明勃然作色，遂循气息追踪，终在此处截住了“贼人”。却见那天庭天兵正带着黑虎，黑虎背上驮着鼓鼓囊囊的储物袋，显然装了不少好东西。

正是巨灵神。
巨灵神见了赵公明，心中咯噔一下。他认出此人乃截教外门大弟子赵公明，道祖鸿钧之再传，通天圣人之得意门生，洪荒之中赫赫有名。
换了旁人，早已跪地求饶。巨灵神却不曾畏惧，反倒上前一步，拱手行礼，不卑不亢：“小神天庭巨灵神，拜见大仙。”
“天庭？”赵公明眉头一挑。
“正是。”巨灵神挺了挺胸，语中颇有几分自得，“小神奉天帝法旨，外出招揽人员，广纳贤才。黑虎道友向往天庭，故愿随小神加入天庭。至于那些天材地宝……”
他顿了顿，“洪荒之大，物华天宝，有德者居之。黑虎道友欲将其栽种到天庭之中，算作投名状。”
赵公明听罢，脸色发黑。他算听明白了——这小子借天庭招人之名，跑到他的地盘，强抢坐骑，顺手牵羊，将他洞府洗劫一空。且观其状，浑然不以为非。
巨灵神犹未觉，继续道：“还请大仙莫要阻拦。普天之下，莫非王土；率土之滨，莫非王臣。三界之内，尽归天帝管辖。小神在天庭之地招揽人才，于情于理，何错之有？”
这话说得理直气壮。
赵公明脸色绿了。
“何错之有？”
content_en:
After the Nantianmen sacrifice was completed, Haotian ordered everyone in the heaven to perform their duties. There are those who go to the underworld to help build the underworld, and there are those who stay in the wilderness to recruit people. Everything is in order.
Haotian returned to the Lingxiao Palace and used the ancestral Qi of the Yuan Dynasty to sacrifice the ancient starry sky and the thirty-third heaven. Since the heaven has been reborn, the backbone of the heaven should also be raised together.
So day after day.
On this day, Haotian was closing his eyes and concentrating, using his authority to connect to the depths of the ancient starry sky. Suddenly, I felt something in my mind, and with a wave of my hand, the Haotian Mirror appeared out of thin air and hung in front of me.
The mirror surface is like waves, gradually reflecting a clear picture.
Haotian looked intently and frowned.
In the painting, there is a burly heavenly soldier wearing golden armor and holding an axe, protecting a black tiger and confronting a person from a distance. The soldier that day had a sinister face and a ferocious appearance, but he exuded an air of innocence.
"Is this the Giant Spirit God?" Haotian was slightly startled. This person is a strange spiritual beast who has attained enlightenment. He is extremely powerful. He was recruited into the heaven by Taibai Jinxing and made a partial general.
According to the memory of his past life, he will become a general in the future and conquer all directions for the heaven - but that will happen a long time later. Today is the first day of court, don't you think this person has already joined your army?
Haotian's eyes moved towards the Taoist. But he was dressed in a green robe, with a face like a crown of jade, three strands of long beard, and a heroic look between his brows. Standing with his hands behind his back, his breath is as deep as the sea, and the power of the Great Luo Jinxian makes people feel palpitated even across the Haotian Mirror.
"Zhao Gongming?" Haotian recognized this person. The top disciple of Jiejiao's outer sect, the brother of Sanxiao, Daluo Jinxian's cultivation level, has entered the realm of "cultivation", which is comparable to that of ordinary monks. He has a lofty position in Jiejiao, and his reputation is not small.
Haotian looked at the confrontation between the two and couldn't help but rub his forehead. The giant spirits are no more than true immortals, not even golden immortals. Zhao Gongming is a Daluo Jinxian who can destroy giant spirits and gods hundreds of times with just one thought. How could the two of them bump into each other and be so tense?
Haotian was not in a hurry to start, but looked down patiently.
---
In the picture, Zhao Gongming stands not far from the Giant Spirit God, and does not deliberately release the pressure. However, the power of the giant Luo is like a mountain, suppressing the grass and trees, and even the air seems to be frozen. His face looked very evil.
"Who allowed you to take away my mount? And plunder the treasures of my cave?" Zhao Gongming said in a low voice, but every word was like thunder, which made the black tiger tremble, "Are you bullying me, Zhao Gongming?"
The whole story is like this——
After the last turmoil in heaven, Zhao Gongming went to Jin'ao Island to listen to the sermon of the leader of Tongtian. A sage's lecture is a once-in-a-lifetime event, so you can't miss it. Before leaving, he sealed the cave and ordered his horse, Black Tiger, to look after the house.
Who would have expected that when he returned from listening to the sermon, when he returned to the cave, he found that the restriction had been broken, his mount was missing, and all the treasures of heaven and earth had been looted!
Zhao Gongming was furious and followed the aura, finally intercepting the "thief" here. But he saw that the Heavenly Soldiers were carrying Black Tiger with him, and Black Tiger was carrying a bulging storage bag on its back, which obviously contained a lot of good things.
It is the giant spirit god.
When the giant spirit god saw Zhao Gongming, his heart skipped a beat. He recognized that this person was Zhao Gongming, the great disciple of the outer sect of Jie Jiao, the reincarnation of Taoist Hongjun, the proud disciple of Tongtian Saint, who was famous in the ancient times.
Anyone else would have already kneeled down and begged for mercy. The Giant Spirit God was not afraid. Instead, he took a step forward, raised his hands and saluted, neither humble nor arrogant: "Little God, the Giant Spirit God of Heaven, pays homage to the Great Immortal."
"Heaven?" Zhao Gongming raised his eyebrows.
"Exactly." The Giant Spirit God puffed up his chest and said with a certain contentment, "The little god obeys the decree of the Emperor of Heaven and goes out to recruit people and recruit talents. Taoist fellow Black Tiger yearns for heaven, so he is willing to join the heaven with the little god. As for those heavenly materials and earthly treasures..."
He paused and said, "It is so vast in ancient times and has so many treasures. The virtuous people live here. Taoist friend Black Tiger wants to plant it in the heaven as a token of fame."
After Zhao Gongming heard this, his face turned dark. He finally understood it - under the pretext of recruiting people from Heaven, this kid went to his territory, robbed his mount, stole sheep, and looted his cave. Looking at its appearance, I don’t think so at all.No.
The Giant Spirit God was still unaware and continued: "Please don't stop me from the Great Immortal. In the whole world, everything is the king's land; on the shore of the land, is it the king's ministers. Within the three realms, everything is under the jurisdiction of the Emperor of Heaven. The little gods recruit talents in the land of heaven, what is wrong with emotion and reason?"
This makes perfect sense.
Zhao Gongming's face turned green.
"What's wrong?"
